ruleName: Mass Cloud resource deletions Time Series Anomaly
customDetectionName: Mass Cloud resource deletions Time Series Anomaly
hypothesis: Mass Cloud resource deletions Time Series Anomaly

reasons: The query requires a 14-day daily time series, series_decompose_anomalies, a positive fitted baseline, and more than 25 deletion events in an anomalous current bucket. A static fixture cannot honestly establish that production baseline.

limitations: The query requires a 14-day daily time series, series_decompose_anomalies, a positive fitted baseline, and more than 25 deletion events in an anomalous current bucket. A static fixture cannot honestly establish that production baseline.
